title: ChatGPT Search ~20% of Google - 1.2B Weekly Users
content:
OpenAI ka consumer product lead Adam Fry
ne ek number bola hai jo search industry
ko hilaa dega.
ChatGPT ki search-like query volume ab
roughly Google ki VOLUME ka 1/5 hai.
Aur weekly active users 1.2 BILLION.
Source clear rakho.
Big Technology ne 3 Nov 2026 ko Adam Fry
ka interview publish kiya.
The Verge ne bhi same day report kiya:
ChatGPT processes about 20% of Google's
search query volume, OpenAI ke hisaab se.
Fry ne Google ka exact source number
publicly nahi diya, so yeh OpenAI ka
estimate hai, independent market share
nahi.
Growth side pe Fry ne kaha: ChatGPT 1
BILLION se 1.2 BILLION weekly active users
pe gaya roughly 60 days mein.
That is about 200 million users in 2 months.
Voice input pe 250 MILLION weekly active users.
Images: 1.5 BILLION images created per week.
Yeh sab numbers OpenAI ke Adam Fry ke hain, company ka apna claim.
Important nuance: search ka matlab kya?
Fry ke hisaab se, har baar user ek aisi
question poochta hai jo web search trigger
karti hai, woh ek search count hota hai.
Ek 20-turn conversation mein multiple
searches ho sakte hain.
Google alag measure karta hai, aur
Alphabet daily query count publish nahi
karta.
Isliye bolo "OpenAI estimates ~20%", mat
bolo "ChatGPT owns 20% of search."
Ab practical: how to use it.
Agar tum business research karte ho,
ChatGPT search ko Google ka replacement
mat samjho.
Use it as a FIRST PASS.
Competitor pages, pricing pages, recent
news - ChatGPT se shortlist banao.
Phir original source pe jaake number verify karo.
Mera workflow: ChatGPT se outline, primary
link se fact-check, phir client ko answer.
Maan lo tumhe ek agency ke liye 3
competitors ka pricing brief banana hai.
Pehle ChatGPT se recent public pages aur
summaries nikaalo.
Phir har pricing claim ko company site ya
screenshot se match karo.
Jo verify nahi hua, usko brief mein mat daalo.
Yeh habit hi AI Solutions Engineer ko alag
karti hai.
Mera take simple hai.
Search volume shift real lag raha hai,
lekin ads aur default habit abhi bhi
Google ke paas hain.
Signal yeh hai: users
answers chahte hain, blue links nahi.
Tumhara product agar source cite kare aur
human verify leave kare, trust badhega.
Hype mat becho. Workflow becho.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
